# truenas_kerberos_realm (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS Kerberos realm by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Kerberos realm name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin_server` (List of String) List of Kerberos admin servers for this realm.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `kdc` (List of String) List of Kerberos domain controllers for this realm.
- `kpasswd_server` (List of String) List of Kerberos kpasswd servers for this realm.
- `primary_kdc` (String) The master Kerberos domain controller for this realm.
